title: Time-based or data-driven: choose triggers for five jobs
objective_text: Choose time-based or data-driven triggers from data availability and dependencies.
scenario: An insurer's data team has five Lakeflow jobs: one waits for files in a volume, one feeds a 06:00 report, one depends on another team's silver tables, one is a stream that must always run, and one is sometimes started by hand.
verifies: You can pick the right component, method or trigger for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can configure it in Databricks: nothing is set up or run here.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
review_notes: Every claim was checked against its source page on 2026-11-09.
